tools.name: docs_search
tools.title: Search Nightdrive's docs
tools.description: Search Nightdrive's own documentation as installed on this machine: the README, docs/*.md, every plugin's README and the keyboard shortcut lists. Use it before guessing how something in Nightdrive works, where a setting is or which command does what. Returns the best-matching sections (heading trail, path, section, excerpt); read one whole with docs_read.

query.description: A few words, e.g. "wallpaper", "update channel", "clipboard history"

tools.name: docs_read
tools.title: Read a Nightdrive doc
tools.description: Read one section of Nightdrive's documentation (with its subsections), by the path and section docs_search showed. Without section: a short file whole, a long one as its list of sections.

path.description: The doc's path as docs_search shows it, e.g. README.md or plugins/mail/README.md

section.description: The section's heading, e.g. "Updating", or its trail "Install › Updating" when a heading repeats

tools.name: shortcuts
tools.title: Keyboard shortcuts
tools.description: Nightdrive's keyboard shortcuts as this desktop has them: only the installed plugins' keys, with the user's own app keys. With query, only the lines that contain all its words (e.g. "workspace", "screenshot").

query.description: Words to filter the lines by; leave out for the whole list
